items.title: HDFC Life posts 14% rise in Sept quarter profit
items.description: Value of new business (VNB) margin expanded 20 basis points to 24.7% against 24.5% a year ago. One basis point is a hundredth of a percentage point. Value of new business grew 12% to ₹2,040 crore.

items.title: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 9% YoY; deposit growth in focus
items.description: HDFC Bank is set to unveil its Q2 results on October 17, 2026, showcasing key financial indicators. Analysts predict a year-on-year rise in net interest income of about 8%, driven by an increase in loans. Profit after tax forecasts vary among brokerages, reflecting a range of expectations regarding the bank's financial health.

items.title: Wipro faces slow recovery as revenue and deal wins lag peers
items.description: Wipro has reported a decline in revenue for the second quarter in a row, contrasting with larger rivals that experienced growth. The total value of new contracts has dropped significantly, indicating delays in project closures. Despite this, management is optimistic about future improvements in deal momentum and operating margins. Slight enhancements were noted in operating margins, attributed to increased efficiency and favorable currency fluctuations.

items.title: Bajaj Housing Finance Q2 Results: PAT rises 18% YoY to Rs 757 crore, AUM grows 25%
items.description: Bajaj Housing Finance reported an 18% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 757 crore, while net interest income increased 10%. Assets under management grew 25% to Rs 1.58 lakh crore, with asset quality remaining largely stable.

items.title: Urban Company Q2 Results: Loss widens to Rs 182 crore; revenue jumps 41% YoY
items.description: Urban Company reported a net loss of Rs 182 crore in Q2FY27 as investments in its quick services business, InstaHelp, weighed on profitability. Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to Rs 537 crore, while orders grew 103%. The company also approved a fresh capital raise of up to Rs 2,500 crore, subject to shareholder approval.

items.title: Yes Bank Q2 preview: Will strong profit, NII growth offer relief for investors amid AT-1 bond saga?
items.description: Yes Bank is expected to post a 48% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 969 crore, driven by robust loan growth and higher NII. However, investor focus remains on the Supreme Court ruling invalidating its Rs 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off, which has pressured the stock.

items.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Results Preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 21% YoY; margins, deposit growth in focus
items.description: ICICI Bank is expected to report 15.8-18% year-on-year growth in net interest income and 15-21% growth in profit after tax in Q2FY27, according to brokerage estimates. Investors will track net interest margins, loan and deposit growth, operating profitability and asset quality, with margin pressure and provisioning trends remaining key monitorables.

items.title: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd Q2 Results: Profit surges 65% to Rs 124 crore
items.description: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals reported a 65 percent increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also jumped by 18.15 percent compared to the previous year. Significant revenue growth was achieved in the electric consumer durable segment, especially in fans and appliances. Overall, the company's total income surged by 18.24 percent in the same period.

items.title: DLF Q2 profit rises to Rs 1,301 crore as luxury project sells out
items.description: DLF reported a 11% year-on-year increase in July-September net profit to Rs 1,301 crore, with sales bookings reaching Rs 3,800 crore. Its Aureva luxury retirement project in Gurugram sold out, while the company maintained a strong net cash position.

items.title: Federal Bank Q2 profit jumps 45% to record Rs 1,386 crore
items.description: Federal Bank posted record Q2 profit of Rs 1,386 crore, up 45% year-on-year, as net interest income climbed 26%. Advances grew 22% and deposits 19%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPAs declining to 1.32% during the September quarter.

items.title: LTM Q2 Results: PAT remains flat at Rs 1,380 crore; revenue rises 14% YoY; co declares Rs 25 per share dividend
items.description: LTM reported a marginal 0.1% decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,379.9 crore, while revenue rose 13.6% to Rs 11,807.6 crore. Enterprise AI and Business AI revenue grew 47%, and the company declared an interim dividend of Rs 25.
